token_prompt: This server needs an access token:
nothing_ingested: Nothing ingested yet. Run meowlaw ingest or use the Ingest page.
home_stats: {corpora} sources · {nodes} provisions and passages · {definitions} definitions · {edges} links.
home_help: Search above, paste a citation, or pick a source on the left. Enriched search resolves citations, adds definitions of the terms you use and follows the citation graph. Basic is keyword ranking only.
home_mcp: Connect an AI client over MCP at {url}.
admin_disabled: The ingest page is off. Set server.allow_ingest = true in meowlaw.toml and restart the server. Without a token it only works when the server is bound to localhost.
admin_upload_hint: Markdown, text, HTML, Akoma Ntoso or USLM XML, DOCX, PDF, or MeowLaw JSON. Uploading a file with the same name again updates that source.
admin_content_summary: A summary of a document not held here
admin_summary: Summary (optional; used for the similarity graph)
admin_working_ingest: Ingesting and rebuilding the index. Large sources take a few minutes…
admin_no_uploads: Nothing uploaded through this page yet. Sources ingested with the command line are not listed here.
admin_remove_confirm: Remove {id} and its uploaded file? Citations to it will become unresolved.
admin_unresolved_hint: Citations that point at nothing loaded. Each row is usually a source to add, or an alias to set in a profile.
admin_preview_corpus: Corpus {corpus} ({kind}), profile {profile}. Nothing has been stored.
admin_breaks: Citations elsewhere that will stop resolving ({n})
admin_unresolved_counts: Unresolved citations: {before} before, {after} after ({fixed} newly resolved).
admin_embedded: Embedded {n} new or changed nodes and rebuilt similarity edges.
compare_too_long: Too long to compare word by word.
